APP-2.1.exact_text: Cover under this policy applies to treatment received between the effective date and the expiry date shown in the schedule, provided the policy is in force on the date of treatment.

APP-2.2.title: Insured members
APP-2.2.exact_text: Only persons named as insured members in the schedule are covered, and only for treatment received while their individual cover is in force.

APP-3.1.title: Outpatient benefit
APP-3.1.exact_text: We will pay for outpatient consultations and treatment prescribed by a registered medical practitioner, subject to the limits and cost-sharing shown in Section 5.

APP-3.2.title: Medical necessity
APP-3.2.exact_text: Treatment is covered only when it is medically necessary for the diagnosis documented by the treating practitioner.

APP-4.1.title: Waiting period
APP-4.1.exact_text: Outpatient benefits are payable only for treatment received after 30 days of continuous cover from the member's cover start date, except for treatment following an accident.

APP-5.1.title: Annual outpatient limit
APP-5.1.exact_text: The maximum we will pay for all outpatient benefits per member in a policy year is USD 1,000.00.

APP-5.2.title: Deductible
APP-5.2.exact_text: No deductible applies to outpatient benefits under this plan.

APP-5.3.title: Outpatient copay
APP-5.3.exact_text: The member pays a fixed copay of USD 20.00 for each outpatient visit. No coinsurance applies to outpatient benefits.
